title: Nauti Times Boat Rentals
specs: Boats equipped with bimini tops, life jackets, anchors, depth finders, live bait wells, rod holders, nautical charts
Renter shall provide a valid credit card as security deposit
Boats accommodate up to 10 people for self-drive rentals; captained boats accommodate up to 6 people
blurb: Guests rent 21-foot Carolina Skiff boats powered by 140HP four-stroke engines, suitable for cruising, fishing, and water sports. Captained boat rentals are available for those who prefer to relax while a professional captain navigates. Extras like tube rentals, water skis, wakeboards, and knee-boards can be added for additional fun.
extraNote: Renter agrees to provide 48 hrs notice of cancellation for no charge; 24 hrs notice results in 50% charge; no show pays 100% of rental fee · If inclement weather or imminent, cancellation with no charge determined from the dock · Rental does not include gas · Wrightsville Beach location near the Seapath Yacht Club and Causeway Drive area; Carolina Beach location at the State Park Marina
